purpose: Development fixtures for embedding and clustering evaluation; these are fictional incidents, not live campus reports.

clusters.ite_wifi_afternoon: Intermittent eduroam outage in ITE during the afternoon
clusters.ite_elevator: ITE east elevator stuck on the first floor
clusters.library_leak: Water leaking from the ceiling on the library second floor
clusters.commons_cooling: Commons dining area air conditioning not cooling
clusters.library_ramp: Delivery boxes blocking the library entrance ramp
clusters.library_wifi: Library wireless outage, separate from the ITE outage
clusters.ite_wifi_evening: New ITE wireless outage more than two hours after the afternoon reports
clusters.commons_leak: Commons restroom sink leak, separate from the library ceiling leak
clusters.library_door: Library automatic entrance door does not open

reports.description: Wi-Fi keeps dropping on the second floor of ITE.
My laptop disconnects from eduroam every minute upstairs in the engineering building.
The wireless connection in ITE level 2 will not stay connected long enough to load a page.
Internet cuts out repeatedly over eduroam on ITE's second floor.
The east elevator in ITE is stuck on floor one.
Pressing the call button does nothing for the east lift in the engineering building lobby.
ITE's eastern elevator has not moved off the first floor and is unusable.
Cannot get upstairs using the east lift at ITE; it stays at the ground-level lobby.
Water is dripping through the ceiling on the library second floor.
A puddle is forming under a leaking ceiling tile upstairs in AOK.
The second-level study area at the library has water falling from overhead.
Ceiling leak beside the tables on floor two of AOK Library.
The air conditioning is not cooling the Commons dining area.
Only warm air comes out of the vents near the food seating in Commons.
It is very hot in the Commons food court; the AC seems broken.
Cooling has stopped working where everyone eats inside Commons.
Delivery boxes are blocking the accessible ramp at the library entrance.
Cannot take a wheelchair up the AOK entry ramp because packages cover the path.
The sloped approach to the library front entrance is obstructed by stacked cartons.
A delivery has left boxes across the library wheelchair ramp.
The printer on ITE floor two has a paper jam.
Pages are stuck inside the second-floor engineering building printer and nothing will print.
ITE level 2 printing station displays a jam error even after resending the job.
The upstairs ITE printer has crumpled paper caught in its rollers.
Wi-Fi keeps dropping on the second floor of the library.
Eduroam disconnects my laptop repeatedly in the AOK study area.
Wi-Fi keeps dropping on the second floor of ITE.
The engineering building wireless network is disconnecting again this evening.
Water is leaking from the sink pipe onto the Commons restroom floor.
The library entrance automatic door does not open when I press the accessibility button.

pair_checks.reason: Paraphrases of the same wireless outage.
Elevator and lift describe the same equipment.
Ceiling drips and the resulting puddle describe the same leak.
Ramp and sloped approach refer to the same obstruction.
Paper jam and crumpled paper describe the same printer incident.
Nearly identical wording but different buildings.
Identical text and building but outside the two-hour window.
Same building and category but wireless and printer incidents differ.
Both water leaks but different buildings and sources.
Both library accessibility issues but different causes.
Same building and time but different equipment.
